name: Buffer Tank (heat storage)
description: A heating / cooling buffer tank (stratified heat storage) - reference Vaillant allSTOR plus (800 l). Temperatures at the top, the middle and the bottom; the stored heat is computed from them. Used by heating-control.

models.name: allSTOR plus VPS 800/3-5 (800 l)
models.purpose: Heating / cooling buffer tank - stores heat between the heat pumps and the consumers, stratified (hot on top).
